disclaimer: Simple wind model: it follows the forecast wind from your field. It is not a smoke dispersion model.
region: in Delhi, Punjab, Haryana and Rajasthan
summary: NASA satellites saw 36 fires in Delhi, Punjab, Haryana and Rajasthan in the last day (50 satellite detections).
What was burning: 21 farm fires, 10 industrial, 4 in built-up areas, 1 forest.
While burning, these fires give off about 1,267 kg of PM2.5 an hour. Most toxic: fire F6 (4.3 km³ of air poisoned per hour, high).
Their smoke will likely reach 817 villages, 235 towns, 54 schools and colleges and 196 hospitals and clinics.
Bass (town): smoke from 8 fires, since about 4:15 am.
Julana (town): smoke from 8 fires, since about 4:40 am.
Rohtak (city): smoke from 7 fires, since about 2:20 am.
notes: Around Punjab and Haryana smoke paths list villages, schools and hospitals; elsewhere (south and west Rajasthan) they list cities and towns only.
